general.description: Ceres is the main and only dwarf planet in the main asteroid belt of Sol. Their inhabitants develloped soon a very independant spacer culture, and the Ceresites anarcho-communists communities were qualified at least "prompt to rebellion" in the Cartel-Sol Era. Rich in water, silicates and rares earth, and counting on the metal of the next large asteroid, Vesta, Ceres is a wealthy world with even agricultural and fishery farm, thanks to its larges pouches of salted water in its underground subsoil.
general.bar: In the Dome-City of Occator, visitors and Ceresites could enjoy the view of icy geysers, which make this place so famous.
